## Members in this source section

IPointCloud3D, IVoxel3D

## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Point-cloud and voxel interfaces
//
// Shedding structure down to a bare point cloud, and conservative rasterization
// into a binary occupancy grid. The derived functionality of both lives in
// `meshes.library.plato`.

// Anything that can shed its structure and yield its points as a bare
// position cloud: meshes, enriched clouds, scan slices.
interface IPointCloud3D
{
    ToPointCloud(x: Self): PointCloud3D;
}

// Anything that can be conservatively rasterized into a binary voxel grid
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Voxel) at a caller-chosen cell size.
interface IVoxel3D
{
    ToOccupancyGrid(x: Self, cellSize: Number): OccupancyGrid3D;
}
```
